findings: No new authorization escalation, deadlock or blocking issue found in this diff.
Registry records only tokens read from authenticated config or issued leases, with bounded SHA-256 fingerprints and account-epoch isolation.
Logout and account switches retain epoch rejection; unknown credentials do not borrow player authentication.
Config writes acquire the provenance mutex, but no provenance-to-config lock nesting was found.
remaining_risk: Cross-process refresh serialization has not been implemented or validated in this change. A cross-process old lease with no local provenance fails closed. The backend target time window showed normal ROTATED usage and no refresh reuse.
